scripts-descriptions.build:full-release: Build the application and complete reviewed initial-data archives for a fresh installation.
scripts-descriptions.build:initial-data: Build the verified data/image archive from tracked repository resources.
scripts-descriptions.dev: Start the local development server at http://localhost:8080 (uses .env and the local database; never resets it).
scripts-descriptions.dev:load-legacy: Rebuild the local database from the reviewed legacy dataset (drops and reloads domain tables; asks first).
scripts-descriptions.migrate: Apply pending forward SQL migrations to the configured database.
scripts-descriptions.initial-data:export: Regenerate the tracked initial-data seed from the verified non-production database.
scripts-descriptions.initial-data:verify: Verify the tracked SQL seed and all 195 private image assets without a database.
scripts-descriptions.primary-refresh:optimize-images: Crop reviewed 1024px PNGs to 640×1024 and create web-optimized WebPs (local tooling only).
scripts-descriptions.primary-refresh:apply: Apply a verified Primärliste refresh plan to a non-production database.
scripts-descriptions.primary-refresh:verify: Verify a Primärliste refresh plan and its non-production target without changing data.
scripts-descriptions.check: Verify initial data, then run unit tests and PHPStan (no database).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the destructive integration suite against the spezitest_test database (see .env.testing).
